source.check: deemed re-elected: no nomination for the division, whose sitting member was returned (Belfast Telegraph, 1930-05-02, p. 14); sat as a member at the meeting reported in the Lisburn Standard, 1930-11-21, p. 7 (monthly meeting, Tuesday 18 November 1930) (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026)

note: Nomination-day report for the sixteen divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each. Eight divisions received a single nomination and are listed here; in Ballymacbrennan, Ballyskeagh, Breda, Carryduff, Drumbo, Edenderry and Ougley no nomination was made and the retiring members were deemed re-elected; five of them are recorded from Lisburn Standard reports of the council's meetings in August-November 1930, and Ballyskeagh and Breda remain unnamed. Blaris is not in the nominations report (Samuel Brown, its 1927 member, sat in August 1930) (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Filed on Friday 30 May 1930, the day appointed by Down County Council for the county and rural district elections (Banbridge Chronicle, 15 March 1930, p. 2); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (provisional) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 8 May 1924 return (John Campbell, Carryduff); the Lisburn Standard report names the member as sitting within six months of 30 May 1930. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
